wardrobe: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game albedo texture atlas, one image, exactly 5 equal columns by 4 equal rows, each cell full bleed edge to edge, perfectly regular grid. NO framing, separations, captions, text, mannequins or characters. Each cell is a flattened square length of painted armor and heraldic fabric, viewed straight on orthographically. Top 55 percent of each panel is the upper garment with stitching or layered construction, lower 45 percent is the hanging richly painted folded material with insignia and finished hem, applique. Medium values, desaturated old-master gouache, cool deep shadows, warm midtones, very selective forged edge highlights, readable at 80px. The five columns always correspond to the same five dark medieval frontier guilds. Column 1 legion: oxblood cloth and blue-black forged steel, beaten brass split sun. Column 2 ember: madder and dark wine, copper flame and phoenix feathers. Column 3 ossuary: soot violet and burial umber, aged ivory carved ribs, reliquary, knot embroidery. Column 4 wildwood: sage, ochre and umber fur and alder bark, stag branches. Column 5 veil ranger: midnight teal and weathered russet layered leather, split-chevron fletching. ROW 1 practical field outfits, quilt stitching and restrained hems. ROW 2 reinforced, cross-laced leather bindings, overlapped protection, narrow brass edging. ROW 3 veteran, sculpted layered metal/feather/bone/bark/leather guards and a clear central class device. ROW 4 mythic, intricate engraved legion sunburst over steel and flowing red cloth; phoenix feather scales in copper and ember; pale, ribbed ossuary relief over purple funerary brocade; elderwood bark, woven pelt and branched crown embroidery; dark teal feather lamellae and silver crested chevrons. Exactly 20 different panels. Material surfaces only, filling the image, rich painterly detail and soft broad cloth folds. Avoid photographic gloss, flat icons and flat swatches. Render landscape aspect 5:4, at high resolution.
details: Use case: stylized-concept. A square game texture atlas consisting of exactly FIVE equally wide columns and FIVE equally tall rows. Precise square cells all touch, no frames, words, labels or gutters. Painted realistic dark fantasy gouache, old northern medieval RPG. Muted neutral-to-light skin midtones, clear broad brushwork, strand clusters, thread seams and leather scuffs. This is for wrapping surfaces of existing models. Five columns represent: 1 weathered stubbled warrior, short dark brown hair + oxblood and iron; 2 woman with auburn hair + crimson and copper cloth; 3 gaunt elderly man with very short ash gray hair + muted plum and ivory; 4 bearded hunter chestnut hair + warm umber and moss; 5 woman with straight dark hair + deep teal/russet leather. Each cell is a macro close-crop painted material filling its ENTIRE square. Row 1 EXACT same anatomical framing across five columns, EXTREME CLOSEUP of BACK of each person's head, from crown at top to nape at bottom, hair partings and directional clumped strands and wisps along nape, no garments or face. Row 2 side of the head, actual HUMAN EAR in center fills the middle 55 percent of each tile, temple skin anterior to it, sideburns at left and hairline above, no eyes. Row 3 dorsal human hand albedo closeup, edge-to-edge skin with wrist at top, tendons in center and row of knuckles across bottom, fingers beyond the crop, no fingernail designs or background, subtle changes of skin tone for the five characters. Row 4 dorsal glove material for each class, wrist edge at top, leather/cloth backing and padded stitched knuckles at bottom: warrior iron-backed leather, mage wine-red wraps, grave priest dark bindings edged with ivory, warden rough hide, ranger russet and teal fingerless bracer. Row 5 each class's own boot leather and upper vamp material, wrist-free, fill the whole square with stitched tongue, curved toe seam across lower third, narrow lace/strap along instep and muddy worn suede edges. Raw surfaces only, no shoe silhouettes, no floating items, no angled perspective of whole objects. Use legible rustic handcrafted details. Exact grid with five rows, five columns, 25 equal tiles.
wildshapes: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted dark-fantasy creature material texture atlas for a game. A precise 4-column by 3-row full-bleed grid of 12 equally sized square tiles, NO BORDERS, words, lettering or gutters. Each tile is the flattened PAINTED SURFACE of one small area of a creature, NOT a picture of a complete animal or a concept sheet. Column 1 gray winter wolf, silvery smoke and charcoal; column 2 heavy brown bear, umber and honey; column 3 stone guardian, blue-gray layered shale and tiny muted sage moss with restrained jade; column 4 antlered grove predator, deep forest-black fur and split golden elderwood bark. TOP ROW: directional fur or overlapping shale covering flank, flecks of warm reflected light and large value masses, fur pointed downward, no limbs or eyes. MIDDLE ROW: orthographic extreme closeup of FRONT of face filling its entire cell, eyes aligned on horizontal midline, muzzle toward bottom, ears beyond crop. Gray wolf has long distinctive pale muzzle, dark nose and amber eyes, bear has a broad brow, short warm muzzle and deep eyes, stone spirit has a carved broad mossy brow, agate eyes, and sculpted rock planes, grove predator has wolf-like face emerging from bark above brow and muted green eyes, no antlers in this crop. BOTTOM ROW: close-up of matching rough paw/toe materials across whole cell, fur and charcoal keratin claws for wolf, golden-brown fur with broad scuffed dark bear toes, fractured mossy flat shale and veins for stone, root-like toes and bark for grove predator. Painterly realistic medieval fantasy monster art, broad directional light described in paint, matte, hand-laid strands, selectively worn edges, soft detailed shadows that read at small scale. Perfect 4:3 landscape aspect, twelve full-bleed tiles. Absolutely no human faces, costumes, lettering, UI, card or framing. Colors ready for further real-time lighting.
